svg.text: PY-5CM*7CM, 24 x 18 isolated pads, 2.54 mm. Seen from the COMPONENT side (column A on the left, row 01 at the top).
Generated by docs/make_perfboard.py (validated); build steps and wire list in docs/PERFBOARD.md.
cols A-E, rows 03-16: no copper, wires or parts
U1 ESP32-DevKitC (WROOM-32D) on two 19-pin female sockets
antenna end at the left (over the keep-out), micro-USB at the right (column X)
rows 05-14 under the devkit stay empty (low parts up to 6 mm would fit)
row 17 = mic A, row 18 = mic B
This is the COMPONENT side. On the copper side
(where you solder) the board is MIRRORED left-right:
column A is on the RIGHT there. The letters A..X and
rows 01..18 are printed on the copper side, so find
holes by name (e.g. N15), not by position.
Bridges, links and wires are all on the COPPER side.
Parts sit on this side, leads through the holes.
Never bridge two pads of different nets.
unused pad (copper on the far side)
pad used by a net (net colour)
bare tinned wire, soldered at every pad
insulated wire (30 AWG wire-wrap), copper side
part body on the component side
I2S data from both mics, GPIO33
GND S15, 5V X15, IO17 P04, IO16 Q04
S16 = star: W4 (mics), W11 (radar), devkit GND
radar OUT (J2 pin 3 / GPIO27), TP for 5V (use C3).
